name: Minntz | Fein
description:
Fein isn’t just loud — it’s one of those flavors real smokers keep coming back to. From the first pull, you get a smooth blast of sweet candy and tropical citrus, layered with a creamy lime note and finished with that signature gas that lingers on the palate. Every hit is clean, flavorful, and consistent all the way through. This strain hits quick with a clear, elevated head high — electric, focused, and creatively dialed-in without
feeling overwhelming. It’s the kind of smoke you can appreciate for both the taste and the effect. If you care about flavor, Fein delivers.
